Deo Gratias.

regions.full_page: April Fool - Death Fooled To-day - Walice Murray, Bad Axe, Mich. 4.25 a.m. phone call - "Could I speak to Fr. S?" "This is Fr. S." "Well Fr: This is Miss Sullivan .... Miss Murray's Brother is just taken to the Receiving Hospital unconscious. The doctors have very lit hope. Will you please put him in the S.M.A. right away?" --- Wallice Murray is enrolled at 4.30 A.M. 8.30 P.M. reported 100% improved --- is up & around within week. Murry's sister Mary pro- missed too - $25.00 a month for three months if her brother were spared. - Terrible head aches now no more.

regions.full_page: Hopeless Case - Has Hopes Again. 2.30 p.m. Just received phone report from sister of Catherine Hartnett, Harper Hosp. that the latter is in very promising condition after attempted operation last Thur. Miss Hartnett declared absolutely hopeless by doctors who opened her abdomen and finding obstructions so complicated that in dispair they simply sewed her up and awaited death.
